Product Details: Power your world with the Luminous 3KVA Solar Inverter, a robust and intelligent solution designed for maximum solar utilization and complete power security. Supporting up to 3000 Wp of solar panel input and operating at a 48V battery bank voltage, this inverter is ideal for large residential and commercial setups. Its pure sine wave output ensures the safety of connected appliances, while the inbuilt isolation transformer protects against grid noise and voltage spikes. With three user-settable modes—Solar, Solar+Grid, and Grid+Solar—you can easily prioritize your preferred power source, enabling maximum savings. An easy-to-use LCD display provides clear insights into system status, making monitoring simple for any user. Additional protections such as short-circuit, reverse polarity, and over-temperature safeguards ensure peace of mind. Certified by BIS as per IS/IEC standards, and backed by a 24-month warranty, the Luminous 3KVA Solar Inverter is a future-ready, smart investment for uninterrupted power and sustainable living.
